title: Overriding a master item on a body page
concept: A body page's OverrideList names a master item so the placeholder is suppressed in favour of the page's own copy.

annotations.note: OverrideList="umasterHeader" lists the master item this page has overridden. The renderer skips stamping that master item.
The page's own replacement rectangle stands in for the suppressed master header — here at 40% tint.
Top-level page items appear as direct children of the spread in document order; that order is the back-to-front z-order.
